evidence: CTX1/H1 bound assistant to inpatient review packets; T1–T5 partition intake, evidence, calculation, save and proof; W8 preserves blocked/pending outcomes.
T1–T5 map to C1–C7/W1–W8 and EV1–EV20; FM1–FM7 link substantive tests; X1 preserves canonical IDs. Sources distinguish brief and H1–H6 hypotheses.
W1–W8 provide exclusive typed outcomes and terminal dispositions; C4 has zero write retries, C5 bounded lookup with changed-intent freeze, C6 durable assigned-record proof.

C1–C7 typed field contracts, H3 explicit adapter verification blocker, H5 queue ownership and escalation are concrete. C3 has no nonempty proration calculation contract; C2 citation validator lacks existence/quote/clause checks.
C3 integer rule arithmetic and fresh versions; C4 server transaction rechecks authority and unique key; F3 separate scoped principals; H4/F4 privacy and retention blockers; C6 record proof.
H1–H6 identify scope, rules, API, privacy, queue and budget assumptions with owners/blockers; CTX3 disclaims production results; C3 abstains on missing rules/facts.

F1/F2 choose durable code worker and one bounded reader over free-running agents/in-memory chain; F1–F4 compare cloud/self-hosted candidates on regional storage, privacy and ownership with verification boundary.
M1 covers sole LLM C2, rejects smaller/larger tiers conditionally, specifies 1.05 expected/2 maximum calls, 12000/1500 tokens, illustrative USD .0378/case and excluded costs; long documents abstain.
FM1–FM7 give case-specific causes, scores, owners, controls, KPIs and EV links for wrong person, edition, room maths, injection, duplicate, uncertain save and queue failure.

EV1–EV17 include self-contained fixtures and exact expected writes/records; EV18–EV20 define strata, labelling, monitoring and gates. Positive linked room-charge proration and invalid/nonexistent evidence citation cases are absent. EV17 also has discharged before admitted, confounding its date-boundary purpose.

R1/R2 define denominators/windows and unknown baselines; R3–R5 phased gates retain human adjudication; R6 cluster randomization, stratification, contamination controls and variance-based power method; R7 names recovery owners.

X1 and build milestones preserve draft-only scope and external blockers; DESIGN.pdf task/workflow are vector and readable at 72dpi, but unimplemented calculation/citation decisions remain in C3/C2 and their exported contracts.

issues.message: Define the positive linked room-rent proportionate deduction formula, charge-class scope and rounding/order, and add a nonempty prorateClasses golden. Existing EV1/EV13 only test an approved empty list; EV4 tests absent rules. The supported positive branch currently requires material implementation invention.

Specify code validation that each citation resolves to an authorized immutable document/page and applicable policy clause, and that quote spans match source text; add nonexistent/wrong-clause negative fixtures. Rejecting uncited claims alone permits invented source references in the evidence-linked review packet.

The policy-date conflict fixture changes admission to July 1 while discharge remains April 3. Use a valid admission/discharge interval so generic invalid chronology cannot mask the intended edition-boundary/conflicting-source test.

limitations: Independent design review only; no business harness, external API, privacy approval or insurer rules executed/verified.
Human-only adjudication is a safe explicit assumption, so missing STP is recorded separately in S8 rather than requiring added autonomy.
PDF summary contains author review labels; independent scores here were derived from canonical evidence, not those scores.
